findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: devParts decodes any glibc-encoded dev_t like gnu_dev_minor, which masks the high part of the minor to 32 bits (0xffffff00). Actual: with a major >= 4096, the high bits of the major leak into the minor (major 0x1234, minor 0x56789 decodes to minor 4295321481). This matches the spec's literal formula and cannot happen with real disk majors (8, 253, 259).
findings.fix: Optionally mask the minor's high part to 32 bits ((dev >> 12n) & 0xffffff00n). Not required.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: the wait-loop test would fail if the last sleep stopped being capped at the limit. Actual: SPEC-07's 150 s / 2 s values divide evenly, so removing the cap keeps every test green. The behaviour is correct today (the holdout's uneven 5 s / 2 s case ends at exactly 5000 ms).
findings.fix: Optionally add an uneven wait/poll case to the fake-clock test.
